redfin.remarks: Welcome to a stylish and spacious Century City residence where timeless design meets effortless modern living. Located in a boutique 15-unit building, this beautifully appointed residence offers a generous layout, abundant natural light, and a private balcony perfect for morning coffee or evening entertaining. With no shared walls and a location above the ground level on the southwest corner of the building, the home offers an added sense of privacy and tranquility. The open living and dining spaces feature beautifully refinished natural oak hardwood floors, a sleek gas fireplace, and oversized sliding doors that open to the expansive balcony. The kitchen features elegant quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances , including a Thermador professional range, Fisher & Paykel refrigerator, and Bosch dishwasher, creating a sophisticated and functional space for everyday living and entertaining. In-unit laundry adds an extra layer of convenience. The sellers have thoughtfully elevated the home with a show-stopping custom bar cabinet that brings serious style to the entertaining space, a modern full bathroom remodel, and a custom natural stone accent wall in the entry hallway. The spacious primary suite features generous closet space, window shutters, and an en-suite bathroom with separate bathtub and shower and a water closet. The home also offers a ton of storage throughout, custom-painted interiors, and access to the building’s indoor sauna . Perfectly located near Hillcrest Country Club, Westfield Century City Mall, Rancho Park Golf Course, Cheviot Hills Tennis and Recreational Center, and local favorites such as Farm Cup Coffee, Chaumont Bakery, and Lumière French Cuisine, this is a prime opportunity to enjoy stylish, comfortable living in one of the Westside’s most desirable locations.
